normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The concession was more apparent than real.
options: A. 讓步看起來有，實質上卻很有限。
B. 讓步實質很大，只是沒人看見。
C. 雙方都已拒絕任何形式的溝通。
D. 說話者在描述真實存在的幻覺。
normal.explain: more apparent than real 指表面大於實質，不能當成充分讓步。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: His apology was conspicuous by its absence.
options: A. 大家都沒注意到他是否道歉。
B. 他沒有道歉，而這一點特別引人注意。
C. 他的道歉聲音特別響亮。
D. 他道歉後立即離席。
normal.explain: conspicuous by its absence 是因缺席而格外明顯；此處缺少的是道歉。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: That is a distinction without a difference.
options: A. 說話者尚未聽過這個區分。
B. 兩者只有一個可以被命名。
C. 那個區分沒有實質差異。
D. 兩者差異重大且無法比較。
normal.explain: distinction without a difference 批評區分只有名義、沒有實質意義。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The account is revealing, albeit not in the way its author intended.
options: A. 這份敘述沒有透露任何事情。
B. 這份敘述透露了重要訊息，但不是作者原本想呈現的那種。
C. 敘述完全符合作者預期，沒有其他訊息。
D. 作者刻意刪掉所有可供理解的內容。
normal.explain: albeit not in the way... 限定揭露方式偏離作者意圖，仍保留 revealing 的肯定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: There is something almost heroic about defending a deadline that everyone knows has already slipped.
options: A. 說話者頒發正式英雄獎章。
B. 說話者主張所有期限都毫無價值。
C. 說話者帶諷刺地描述捍衛一個已經延誤的期限。
D. 說話者確認期限尚未到而且人人準時。
normal.explain: almost heroic 與 everyone knows has already slipped 的矛盾支撐諷刺，沒有否定一切期限。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: For all its professed neutrality, the report gives remarkably little space to the opposing evidence.
options: A. 報告完全不宣稱中立。
B. 報告把全部篇幅用在反面證據。
C. 反面證據已被證明全部造假。
D. 報告自稱中立，卻很少呈現反面證據。
normal.explain: For all 表讓步；professed 與 little space 形成宣稱與做法的落差。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I grant the point, though it scarcely disposes of the larger objection.
options: A. 我接受這一點，因此撤回所有反對。
B. 我要求丟棄比較大的物品。
C. 我接受這一點，但它幾乎沒有解決較大的質疑。
D. 我拒絕這一點，也承認所有質疑已解決。
normal.explain: grant 是承認，scarcely disposes of 是否定已充分解決；有限承認不等於撤回主要質疑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: One could admire the ingenuity of the justification without being remotely persuaded by it.
options: A. 欣賞巧思就必然接受辯解。
B. 辯解已獲所有人一致認同。
C. 說話者否認辯解有任何巧思可言。
D. 即使欣賞辯解的巧思，也可能完全不被說服。
normal.explain: without being remotely persuaded 把技巧評價與論證說服力分開；could 表示可有這種立場。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The policy has acquired an air of inevitability that owes more to repetition than to any demonstration of necessity.
options: A. 政策看似無可避免，主要因反覆宣傳，而非必要性已獲證明。
B. 政策的必要性已透過充分證據確立。
C. 政策從未被任何人重複提及。
D. 說話者已證明政策在所有情況都不可能實施。
normal.explain: owes more to A than B 比較來源；質疑必然感的依據，不是證明政策不能實施。

normal.desc: 【語意】The author’s praise is conspicuously faint. Which description best captures this?
options: A. Approval is expressed so weakly that it suggests reservations.
B. Approval is enthusiastic and unequivocal.
C. The author gives no indication of any evaluation.
D. The praise is inaudible because the recording failed.
normal.explain: faint praise 是力道很弱的稱讚，常隱含保留；conspicuously 表示這種微弱很明顯。

normal.desc: 【慣用語】The agreement was signed, but the devil is in the detail. What is the warning?
options: A. The parties must now discuss supernatural beliefs.
B. Small provisions may create significant practical difficulties.
C. The agreement has no provisions of any kind.
D. Signing has resolved every practical difficulty.
normal.explain: the devil is in the detail 提醒細節可能藏著重大問題；不表示簽約毫無作用。

normal.desc: 【語域】Which revision most precisely avoids claiming that a result applies without exception?
options: A. The result can never hold under any circumstances.
B. The result is universally valid without qualification.
C. The result holds in most, though not all, of the cases examined.
D. The result holds in every conceivable case.
normal.explain: most, though not all 明確限制適用範圍；其餘都是絕對化陳述。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The concession was grudging rather than gracious. What does this imply?
options: A. It was legally invalid because it was generous.
B. It was made reluctantly, without much goodwill.
C. It was offered eagerly as a generous gift.
D. It was never made under any circumstances.
normal.explain: grudging 是不情願的，gracious 是親切大方的；態度差異不等於讓步不存在或無效。

normal.desc: 【反諷】After a committee postponed a decision for the sixth time, a columnist wrote: Another triumph of decisive leadership. How is triumph being used?
options: A. Neutrally, to identify the committee’s formal title.
B. As evidence that all six decisions were successful.
C. Ironically, to criticise repeated failure to decide.
D. Literally, to celebrate a prompt final decision.
normal.explain: 反覆延後與 decisive leadership 矛盾，支持反諷解讀；不是單憑正面字面就判定稱讚。

normal.desc: 【論證】The absence of recorded complaints is scarcely evidence of universal satisfaction. Which claim is being rejected?
options: A. Some satisfied users choose not to complain.
B. Records can contain complaints.
C. Some complaints may never be recorded.
D. No recorded complaints necessarily means everyone is satisfied.
normal.explain: 作者否定從沒有紀錄直接推出人人滿意；其他選項與這項批評相容。

normal.desc: 【立場】To call the reform cosmetic is not to deny that appearances matter. Which interpretation respects both parts?
options: A. Appearances never have any consequences.
B. The writer has withdrawn the description cosmetic.
C. The reform may change presentation rather than substance, while presentation can still have value.
D. The reform necessarily transforms every underlying institution.
normal.explain: 作者保留 cosmetic 的批評，同時不否定表象的價值；不是撤回描述。

normal.desc: 【短文】A review describes a novel as meticulously researched but curiously inert. It adds that the characters seem assembled to illustrate historical forces rather than to pursue desires of their own. What is the central criticism?
options: A. The novel contains too few verified historical details.
B. The characters are too independent of the historical setting.
C. The reviewer objects to every form of historical fiction.
D. Historical accuracy has not produced convincing dramatic vitality.
normal.explain: 研究細緻受到肯定，批評在人物像歷史論點工具、缺乏生命力；不是考據不足。

normal.desc: 【短文】An official says that the consultation demonstrated public support. The published summary, however, counts silence as assent and excludes responses deemed outside the remit, without specifying the criterion. What most undermines the claim?
options: A. The method may inflate apparent support through assumptions and selective inclusion.
B. The summary contains any numerical information at all.
C. Every participant explicitly opposed the proposal.
D. Consultation can never provide useful evidence.
normal.explain: 把沉默視為同意、排除標準不明可能偏高支持度；不能斷言所有人反對或諮詢一概無用。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：不坦誠而故作天真的
請唸出單字：行事審慎周全
請唸出：有爭議的論點；也可指已無實際意義的問題
請唸出：沒有實質差異的區分
請唸出：讓步表面大於實質
normal.ans: THE CONCESSION IS MORE APPARENT THAN REAL
normal.speak: the concession is more apparent than real
normal.vocabId: R8:THE CONCESSION IS MORE APPARENT THAN REAL

normal.desc: 請唸出：他宣稱的中立聽來相當空洞
normal.ans: HIS PROFESSED NEUTRALITY RINGS DECIDEDLY HOLLOW
normal.speak: his professed neutrality rings decidedly hollow
normal.vocabId: R8:HIS PROFESSED NEUTRALITY RINGS DECIDEDLY HOLLOW

normal.desc: 請拼出：不坦誠而故意裝作不知情的（D 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：D I S I N G _ N U O U S (不坦誠而故意裝作不知情的)
請拼出：採取行動前審慎考慮各種情況（C 開頭，14 個字母）
請拼出：拒絕改變立場或妥協的頑固態度（I 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：I N T R _ N S I _ E N C E (拒絕改變立場或妥協的頑固態度)
請拼出：表面看似合理但實際有誤的（S 開頭，8 個字母）
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Her acceptance was gracious, though hardly effusive.
options: A. 她的接受完全沒有任何禮貌。
B. 她接受得很有風度，但並不熱情洋溢。
C. 她熱情到掩飾不了對安排的反感。
D. 她拒絕了邀請，卻詳細稱讚主辦方。
normal.explain: gracious 肯定態度得體，hardly effusive 限定情感表達不熱烈。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The promise is generous in scope and elusive in substance.
options: A. 承諾已逐項兌現而且沒有爭議。
B. 承諾只涉及一筆已確認的捐款。
C. 承諾涵蓋很廣，但實質內容難以捉摸。
D. 承諾內容具體，只是涵蓋範圍很窄。
normal.explain: scope 與 substance 對比，批評承諾廣泛卻缺少可掌握的實質。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not wish to mistake compliance for enthusiasm.
options: A. 我確定配合必定出於熱情支持。
B. 我希望大家停止配合並公開反對。
C. 我認為熱情和配合不可能同時存在。
D. 我不想把配合誤認為熱情支持。
normal.explain: 不把行為上的配合直接推論成內在熱情；並未主張兩者互斥。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The debate has become a proxy for anxieties that neither side is particularly keen to name.
options: A. 雙方只是因無法到場而請人代理辯論。
B. 雙方已同意焦慮與辯論毫不相干。
C. 辯論成了雙方不太願明說的焦慮的替代表達。
D. 辯論已把雙方的所有焦慮清楚命名。
normal.explain: proxy 在此指替代載體；not keen to name 是不願直說，不等於沒有焦慮。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is a curious kind of participation in which residents may speak at length but never influence the question being asked.
options: A. 居民不但可設定議題，也已掌握最終決策。
B. 說話者只質疑居民講話時間過短。
C. 所有居民都已拒絕參加任何討論。
D. 居民雖可充分發言，卻無權影響議題如何設定，這種參與值得質疑。
normal.explain: may speak at length 與 never influence 議題形成程序參與和實質影響力的落差。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The appeal to local identity is no less calculated for being sincerely felt.
options: A. 即使對在地認同感受真誠，訴諸它仍可能是精心盤算的。
B. 只要感受真誠，就能證明完全沒有策略考量。
C. 說話者認定在地認同一定都是虛構的。
D. 策略考量已使所有人不再有任何認同感。
normal.explain: no less...for being... 否定真誠與策略互斥的假設；不是否定真誠。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The charm of the place survives in spite of the branding, not because of it.
options: A. 品牌包裝已被證明是魅力的唯一來源。
B. 地方魅力因品牌包裝已徹底消失。
C. 說話者認為地方從來沒有任何魅力。
D. 地方魅力在品牌包裝下仍存續，並不是品牌包裝創造的。
normal.explain: in spite of 與 not because of 明確區分存續與成因，也沒有說魅力已消失。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is sold as a return to simplicity entails a degree of staging that the promotional material is understandably reluctant to acknowledge.
options: A. 宣傳所謂重返簡樸其實需要不少安排，文宣不太願承認這一點。
B. 宣傳明白揭露了全部安排並以此作為主要賣點。
C. 體驗完全沒有安排，因此無法販售。
D. 說話者保證所有參加者都已識破宣傳。
normal.explain: sold as 與 staging 揭露自然簡樸形象背後的製作；understandably 是可理解其動機，不一定贊同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am less concerned by the decision itself than by the ease with which a temporary expedient has been recast as an enduring principle.
options: A. 我確定這項決定已被正式撤銷。
B. 我更在意權宜措施被輕易改說成長久原則，而不只是決定本身。
C. 我主要反對所有臨時措施，不在意它們如何被解釋。
D. 我認為原則越短暫越值得支持。
normal.explain: less...than... 定位主要關切；expedient 是權宜辦法，recast as 是重新包裝成。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The apology acknowledged hurt without conceding wrongdoing. What distinction is being maintained?
options: A. The apology explicitly promises compensation for wrongdoing.
B. Recognition of the effect is separated from acceptance of fault.
C. Acceptance of fault is offered as the reason for the hurt.
D. The speaker denies that anyone experienced hurt.
normal.explain: 承認有人受傷與承認自己有過錯被刻意分開；沒有否定感受，也沒有承諾賠償。

normal.desc: 【慣用語】The town’s new slogan has acquired a life of its own. What does this most naturally imply?
options: A. It has been formally withdrawn by the people who created it.
B. Its meaning has remained entirely fixed since its introduction.
C. Its use and interpretation have developed beyond its creators’ control.
D. It is still used only in the precise context its creators specified.
normal.explain: acquire a life of its own 指事物開始獨立發展，不再由創造者完全掌控。

normal.desc: 【語域】Which sentence most tactfully questions whether a generous-looking offer has meaningful substance?
options: A. I wonder which of the promised benefits should be delivered first.
B. I appreciate that the offer resolves the practical difficulty completely.
C. I suggest we accept the offer as a sufficient remedy without further discussion.
D. I wonder how much practical difference the offer would actually make.
normal.explain: how much...actually make 委婉質疑實質效果；其餘都預設有明確利益或已充分解決。

normal.desc: 【語意】The concession has been dressed up as a matter of principle. What reservation does dressed up convey?
options: A. A concession has been rejected because it was too costly.
B. The principle itself has been explained without any rhetorical framing.
C. A less elevated motive may be presented in more respectable terms.
D. A genuine principle has been openly abandoned without justification.
normal.explain: dress up as 暗示包裝成更體面的說法；may 保留推論，不直接證明所有原則都虛假。

normal.desc: 【立場】The critic calls the performance exquisitely controlled, perhaps to a fault. What does the qualification add?
options: A. The performance is technically uncontrolled despite appearances.
B. The critic is uncertain whether any precision is present.
C. Spontaneity is praised as the performance’s main strength.
D. The precision may come at the expense of spontaneity.
normal.explain: to a fault 指優點過度反而成缺點；控制精準可能損及自然流動。

normal.desc: 【語用】When a colleague says, I admire your confidence, immediately after warning that a plan has no contingency, which reading best fits the context?
options: A. The remark may politely signal that the confidence exceeds the available safeguards.
B. The colleague explicitly confirms that the safeguards are sufficient.
C. The colleague withdraws the earlier concern about contingency planning.
D. The remark necessarily expresses sincere agreement with the entire plan.
normal.explain: 前文缺乏備案支持含蓄保留的讀法，但語氣可能性不能誇大成一定反諷。

normal.desc: 【範圍】Not every attempt to make the festival inclusive was misguided. Which conclusion is licensed?
options: A. Most such attempts were well judged.
B. None of the attempts caused any difficulty.
C. Every such attempt improved attendance.
D. At least one such attempt was not misguided.
normal.explain: not every 只保證不是全部都錯，至少有一個不錯；不能推出大多數或成效。

normal.desc: 【短文】A travel essay celebrates a village as untouched by modern life, while mentioning the bus that brings visitors, the online bookings that fund its guesthouses, and residents’ efforts to improve mobile coverage. What is the essay’s blind spot?
options: A. Its ideal of authenticity discounts residents’ active engagement with modern systems.
B. Its transport information proves the village has no surviving traditions.
C. Its account demonstrates that residents oppose every visitor.
D. Its focus on infrastructure establishes that the essay is a technical report.
normal.explain: 文章自身列出的現代系統和居民追求便利，與 untouched 的浪漫框架矛盾；不表示傳統全消失。

normal.desc: 【短文】The mediator’s summary was praised as even-handed. Yet it described one side’s demands as aspirations and the other’s as grievances, while claiming merely to reproduce the language used. What deserves scrutiny?
options: A. Whether all aspirations are necessarily less justified than all grievances.
B. Whether selective wording shapes sympathy despite the claim of neutral reporting.
C. Whether either side was allowed to submit a written statement at all.
D. Whether even-handed summaries must assign identical numbers of words to each side.
normal.explain: 不同框架可能引導同情，即使聲稱引用原話仍需檢查選擇；不預設哪一類要求一定較合理。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不加保留地承認自己有錯
B. 因缺少資訊而暫停調查
C. 利用用語含糊或多義來避免明確表態
D. 將所有用語逐一精確定義
normal.explain: equivocation 指含糊其詞、閃避承諾，也可利用詞義轉換造成論證歧義。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 為了清楚而精簡重點的措辭
B. 將事件按照日期排列的方式
C. 只用單一字母標示的縮寫
D. 不直接說明而使用迂迴冗長的措辭
normal.explain: circumlocution 指繞圈子說話，核心是間接而冗長。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 就實際效果而言
B. 只供理論討論而與實際無關
C. 為了完成每一項原訂程序
D. 在任何想像得到的情境都毫無例外
normal.explain: for all practical purposes 限定在實際作用層次，不等於所有邏輯情境都絕對相同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The concession is significant chiefly for what it leaves untouched.
options: A. 這項讓步已全面改變所有爭議事項。
B. 說話者只在稱讚讓步的金額很大。
C. 說話者確認沒有任何問題尚待處理。
D. 這項讓步主要因仍未觸及的部分而值得注意。
normal.explain: chiefly for what it leaves untouched 將焦點放在未改變的核心，不是全面讓步。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not imputing bad faith; I am questioning whether the framework can register the harm it claims to prevent.
options: A. 我不是指控動機不誠，而是質疑框架能否辨認它宣稱要防止的傷害。
B. 我已確定設計者故意製造傷害。
C. 我承認框架已完整辨識所有傷害。
D. 我只在詢問框架的名稱是否容易記住。
normal.explain: 區分動機指控與框架識別能力的批評，register 在此為察覺或記錄。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The choice is presented as voluntary, though refusal exacts a price that is nowhere acknowledged in the description.
options: A. 所有使用者都被明文禁止拒絕。
B. 選擇被說成自願，但拒絕有代價，而說明並未承認。
C. 說明已完整揭露拒絕的所有代價。
D. 拒絕完全不會帶來任何後果。
normal.explain: 名義自願與未揭露的拒絕代價可並存，不等於法律上完全不能拒絕。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We risk laundering a judgement into an apparently impersonal result simply by expressing it numerically.
options: A. 只因用數字表達，我們可能把判斷包裝成看似客觀無涉個人的結果。
B. 用數字表示就一定能消除任何價值判斷。
C. 說話者認定所有數字都必然是偽造的。
D. 說話者只關心數字排列的美觀。
normal.explain: laundering 在此比喻洗去主觀來源的外觀；risk 不是斷言所有量化都無效。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The qualification is framed as a minor technicality, when it is in fact doing most of the work of insulating the claim from any conceivable counterexample.
options: A. 主張因缺少任何限定而變得完全無法理解。
B. 這項限定被說成小細節，實際上卻主要靠它讓主張避開任何可能的反例。
C. 限定使主張更容易被具體反例推翻。
D. 所有可能反例都已逐一接受實驗檢驗。
normal.explain: insulating from counterexample 是避免反證，doing most of the work 指限定承擔主要防護作用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What passes for transparency here is an abundance of detail that makes the consequential choices harder, rather than easier, to discern.
options: A. 資訊完全沒有公開，所以不存在任何透明外觀。
B. 只要公開資訊很多，就必然已達成實質透明。
C. 這裡看似透明，其實大量細節反而讓關鍵選擇更難辨認。
D. 所有細節都已精確指出最有影響的選擇。
normal.explain: passes for 指被當成；大量資訊與可理解性並非同一件事。

normal.desc: 【語意】The explanation is technically accurate but pragmatically evasive. What is the criticism?
options: A. Its wording is imprecise but addresses the concern directly.
B. Its author has acknowledged that no explanation is possible.
C. Its literal correctness does not amount to answering the relevant concern.
D. Its usefulness depends on correcting a factual error.
normal.explain: literal accuracy 與是否正面回應關切不同；批評在迴避，而不是已指出事實錯誤。

normal.desc: 【語用】A company says it has no plans to discontinue a service. Which conclusion goes beyond that wording?
options: A. No current discontinuation plan is being announced.
B. Future discontinuation remains logically compatible with the statement.
C. The statement leaves future decisions open.
D. The company guarantees that the service will never be discontinued.
normal.explain: no plans 是目前未有計畫，不是對永遠維持服務的保證；其餘都保留時態與範圍。

normal.desc: 【語意】The account is self-exculpatory rather than dispassionate. What distinction is being drawn?
options: A. It seeks to absolve its author rather than assess events neutrally.
B. It admits responsibility rather than considering other causes.
C. It avoids any reference to its author’s role in the events.
D. It openly abandons every attempt to justify the author’s conduct.
normal.explain: self-exculpatory 指為自己開脫；dispassionate 指不受情緒或私利左右的冷靜判斷。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The announcement turns an obligation into a favour. Which wording best illustrates that criticism?
options: A. We will issue the refund because the contract requires us to do so.
B. The contract requires a refund, and we acknowledge that obligation.
C. The refund is being processed in fulfilment of our contractual duty.
D. As a gesture of goodwill, we will issue the refund already required under the contract.
normal.explain: 把合約本已要求的退款稱為 goodwill，將義務包裝成施惠；其餘都明認義務。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The claim is unproven, which is not the same as its being disproved. Which position is consistent with this?
options: A. The available evidence does not establish it, but may not establish its falsity either.
B. The claim is established as false merely because proof is absent.
C. The claim must be accepted as true until someone disproves it.
D. A lack of proof rules out the possibility of future evidence.
normal.explain: 未證實與已證偽不同；也不因此要求先相信或否定未來證據。

normal.desc: 【語用】An executive answers a question about data sales by saying: We do not sell names or email addresses. What remains unaddressed?
options: A. Whether selling names has been explicitly admitted.
B. Whether other kinds of user data are sold.
C. Whether names and email addresses are examples of data.
D. Whether the executive has made a statement about any data.
normal.explain: 回答只排除姓名與電郵的販售，未涵蓋其他資料；不能當成全面否認。

normal.desc: 【立場】That the policy is explicable does not make it defensible. What does this allow the writer to do?
options: A. Account for why it arose while still withholding approval.
B. Approve the policy because its origins can be explained.
C. Deny that anyone could identify the policy’s origins.
D. Treat every explanation as a moral justification.
normal.explain: explicable 可解釋成因，defensible 可辯護正當性；兩者可分開。

normal.desc: 【短文】A platform calls its recommended settings the neutral default. Yet those settings maximise data sharing, while declining requires several additional steps. The wording treats the selected baseline as if it preceded any choice. What assumption is challenged?
options: A. That data sharing has been formally prohibited under the default settings.
B. That a default can be treated as independent of the design decisions that establish it.
C. That every user consciously selected the baseline after comparing the options.
D. That every additional step necessarily prevents all users from declining.
normal.explain: 預設值也是設計選擇，不是選擇之前自然而然的中立狀態；不需斷言人人無法拒絕。

normal.desc: 【短文】An article describes a system’s errors as occasional deviations from an otherwise objective process. Critics argue that the definition of a correct outcome itself reflects choices about which interests count. Where do the positions diverge?
options: A. Over whether occasional errors should simply be counted more carefully.
B. Over whether the process has a measurable output at all.
C. Over whether the baseline used to identify error is itself open to normative scrutiny.
D. Over whether any incorrect output has ever occurred in the system.
normal.explain: 批評深入到正確基準中的價值選擇，超越把偏差視為孤立技術誤差。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：以推動特定立場為目的而有偏向的
請唸出單字：說話時預先視為成立的前提
請唸出：經巧妙限定範圍的保證
請唸出：不帶私利判斷的表象
請唸出：字面正確並不保證溝通坦誠
normal.ans: LITERAL ACCURACY DOES NOT GUARANTEE COMMUNICATIVE CANDOUR
normal.speak: literal accuracy does not guarantee communicative candour
normal.vocabId: R8:LITERAL ACCURACY DOES NOT GUARANTEE COMMUNICATIVE CANDOUR

normal.desc: 請唸出：這項限定幾乎掏空了保證的實質
normal.ans: THE QUALIFICATION RENDERS THE ASSURANCE ALMOST VACUOUS
normal.speak: the qualification renders the assurance almost vacuous
normal.vocabId: R8:THE QUALIFICATION RENDERS THE ASSURANCE ALMOST VACUOUS

normal.desc: 請拼出：為淡化不快或敏感事物而用的委婉語（E 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：不受情緒或私利影響而冷靜的（D 開頭，13 個字母）
請拼出：看似有內容卻缺少實質意義的（V 開頭，7 個字母）
填空題：P R E V A R _ C A T I O N (藉含糊或迂迴說法避免說出真相)
填空題：D I S I _ T E R _ S T E D (不受個人利益影響而公正的)
填空題：I N _ I _ I _ U S (可能引起不滿或不公平比較的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把樂曲改成無人聲的演奏版本
B. 取消所有衡量工具的程序
C. 完全不考慮任何實際目的
D. 把人或事物當成達成另一目的的工具
normal.explain: 在本題抽象語境 instrumentalisation 指工具化，不是配器。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在他人能表態前已成定局的事
B. 仍未提出任何內容的計畫
C. 經所有相關者事先一致同意的決定
D. 只為討論而不會執行的假設
normal.explain: fait accompli 是既成事實，常使他人難以再改變。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在沒有任何限制下自由決定
B. 因被勉強容許而暫時存在
C. 因獲得積極支持而永久保障
D. 為了公開表達對痛苦的認同
normal.explain: on sufferance 指被容忍而非受到積極接納。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The designation does not merely describe the area; it helps make a particular future for it appear natural.
options: A. 這個稱呼不只描述地區，也使某種未來走向看似自然。
B. 稱呼對人們理解未來完全沒有作用。
C. 該地區的未來已由自然災害唯一決定。
D. 說話者只是在比較地名發音。
normal.explain: 描述性標籤也能形塑期待，not merely 表兼有建構作用。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is defended as pragmatism may amount to accepting constraints that the proposal itself has helped to create.
options: A. 說話者認為提案一定沒有任何可行部分。
B. 被辯護為務實的做法，可能是在接受提案本身促成的限制。
C. 所有限制都已被證明完全來自外部。
D. 務實做法已自動消除全部限制。
normal.explain: may amount to 保留批評可能性，重點在限制並非全然外生。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The residents are visible in the account as obstacles to be managed, rather less so as people whose judgement might be worth hearing.
options: A. 居民在敘述中完全沒有被提到。
B. 說話者認為居民判斷不值得聽。
C. 居民被描寫成待處理障礙，較少被當成值得傾聽判斷的人。
D. 敘述把居民視為唯一有權決定的人。
normal.explain: visible as A rather less as B 對照再現角色，不是居民完全缺席。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The scheme promises inclusion on terms that leave the existing hierarchy conspicuously intact.
options: A. 方案明文拒絕任何形式的參與。
B. 方案承諾納入參與，但條件明顯保留了原有階序。
C. 方案已把原有權力關係全部顛倒。
D. 原有階序在方案提出前就已不存在。
normal.explain: inclusion 與權力不變可以並存；批評是參與條件未改變階序。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am not persuaded that giving a burden a monetary equivalent makes it commensurable with the benefits enjoyed by entirely different people.
options: A. 只要標出金額，公平問題就必定解決。
B. 說話者已證明任何兩個數字都不能比較。
C. 我不認為把負擔換成金額，就足以使它與另一群人享有的利益具有可比較性。
D. 所有人承受負擔與享有利益的比例已完全相同。
normal.explain: 質疑貨幣化是否充分處理跨群體代價，不是否定一切數值比較。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The promise to preserve what matters is reassuring only until we notice who has reserved the right to decide what matters.
options: A. 所有相關者已平等分享界定重要性的權力。
B. 說話者確認沒有任何值得保存的事物。
C. 承諾因使用簡單字詞而自動失效。
D. 保存重要事物的承諾看似安心，但還要檢視誰保留了界定重要性的權力。
normal.explain: 批評指向價值界定權，並不否定保存本身。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The proposal is expedient rather than farsighted. What contrast is intended?
options: A. It is impractical now but certain to succeed later.
B. It is rejected because it has no immediate use.
C. It has been designed solely for a distant future need.
D. It serves an immediate practical need without demonstrating long-term wisdom.
normal.explain: expedient 肯定眼前方便可用，farsighted 指長遠眼光；未保證未來成敗。

normal.desc: 【語用】The report calls the displaced shops commercially marginal. What does this wording risk doing?
options: A. Treating limited profitability as a reason to discount their wider significance.
B. Establishing that every shop operated without customers.
C. Admitting that profitability has no bearing on the report’s categories.
D. Proving that the shops had no importance to local residents.
normal.explain: marginal 的商業框架可能淡化社會角色；風險不是已證明店家毫無意義。

normal.desc: 【文法】So pervasive ___ that alternatives were scarcely discussed.
options: A. the assumption being
B. was the assumption
C. the assumption was
D. has the assumption
normal.explain: So＋形容詞置首的此倒裝結構為 So pervasive was the assumption that...。

normal.desc: 【語意】The consultation offered recognition without redress. Which distinction is expressed?
options: A. The concerns were acknowledged without a remedy being provided.
B. A remedy was provided without any concern being acknowledged.
C. Every concern was dismissed as factually impossible.
D. Recognition was made conditional on residents withdrawing complaints.
normal.explain: recognition 是承認，redress 是補救；兩者可以分開存在。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The policy is not indefensible merely because its benefits are uneven. Which interpretation preserves the double qualification?
options: A. The writer denies that any unevenness exists.
B. Uneven benefits alone do not settle whether the policy can be justified.
C. Uneven benefits prove the policy is justified.
D. The policy is justified only when benefits are perfectly equal.
normal.explain: not indefensible 與 merely because 排除單一理由足以否定，不等於已證成政策。

normal.desc: 【立場】The critic accepts the arithmetic while disputing the accounting. What does this most plausibly mean here?
options: A. The accounts have been accepted as comprehensive in every respect.
B. The critic objects to using any numbers in public decisions.
C. The sums may be correct, while the choice of what enters them is contested.
D. The arithmetic is incorrect because figures cannot be added.
normal.explain: 區分運算正確與成本利益選取範圍是否合理。

normal.desc: 【論證】If the proposal’s necessity is inferred from the absence of alternatives, what question is crucial?
options: A. Whether every conceivable alternative can be implemented simultaneously.
B. Whether plausible alternatives have been excluded by how the problem was framed.
C. Whether the proposal has been given an attractive title.
D. Whether necessity and popularity are always interchangeable.
normal.explain: 未有替代可能源自框架排除，而非客觀必然；應檢視可行替代的範圍。

normal.desc: 【短文】A regeneration plan promises to preserve the district’s character while making it attractive to a different clientele. Existing residents appear in the brochure as part of the atmosphere, but not as intended beneficiaries. What tension is exposed?
options: A. The brochure openly promises that no physical structure will change.
B. Preserving character is shown to require excluding all visitors.
C. The people who embody the valued character may be excluded from the future being marketed.
D. Every new customer must inevitably displace an existing resident.
normal.explain: 居民作為地方特色被使用，卻未被納入受益者，形成保存敘事中的排除。

normal.desc: 【短文】The appraisal assigns a monetary value to every listed benefit and calls the result comprehensive. An unlisted loss of informal meeting places is treated as outside its remit. What is the central issue?
options: A. Expressing benefits in money proves that every valuation is fraudulent.
B. The omitted loss must necessarily exceed every listed benefit.
C. An appraisal cannot ever define a scope for its work.
D. The claimed completeness depends on a prior decision about which effects qualify for inclusion.
normal.explain: 全面性宣稱取決於先界定哪些影響能算入；不預設漏算損失必大於所有利益。

請唸出單字：把事物當成可交易商品的過程
請唸出：尚未正式決定卻已可預料的結果
請唸出：看似無可避免的表象
請唸出：僅有承認不等於有意義的補救

normal.speak: recognition alone does not amount to meaningful redress
normal.vocabId: R8:RECOGNITION ALONE DOES NOT AMOUNT TO MEANINGFUL REDRESS

normal.ans: A CONVENIENT BOUNDARY CAN CONCEAL A CONSEQUENTIAL CHOICE
normal.speak: a convenient boundary can conceal a consequential choice
normal.vocabId: R8:A CONVENIENT BOUNDARY CAN CONCEAL A CONSEQUENTIAL CHOICE

normal.desc: 請拼出：能以共同標準作有意義比較的（C 開頭，13 個字母）
請拼出：把事物視為達成另一目的之手段的（I 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：以預設終點或目的來解釋發展的（T 開頭，12 個字母）

填空題：P A _ I _ A (事物隨時間形成的外觀或表面質感)

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 為開脫或特定結論而作的牽強細密辯解
B. 以簡潔措辭承認論點不足
C. 為研究案例建立中立清單
D. 公開說明無法判斷的原因
normal.explain: casuistry 常帶貶義，指看似細密卻牽強的辯解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 要求不再改善任何細節的命令
B. 理想上無可挑剔卻難以實行的建議
C. 已通過實務驗證的最低可行標準
D. 只允許專家提出意見的會議
normal.explain: counsel of perfection 批評建議理想但實行困難。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 為減少爭議而暫時不表態
B. 把同一論點簡化成兩句
C. 對細微而不重要的差別過度爭辯
D. 把關鍵原則清楚區分
normal.explain: split hairs 指過度計較不重要的細節；與必要精確不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would distinguish an exacting standard from a standard exacted without regard to the conditions of learning.
options: A. 我認為標準只要清楚就已顧及所有學習條件。
B. 我會區分要求嚴格的標準，與不顧學習條件而強加的標準。
C. 我把所有嚴格標準都視為同等不合理。
D. 我主張學習條件應取代任何表現標準。
normal.explain: exacting 要求高，exacted 強制要求；區分標準強度與施行方式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The qualification is not a retreat from the claim but a specification of the circumstances in which the claim has force.
options: A. 主張無論條件如何都保持原樣成立。
B. 限定只是在避免說明適用範圍。
C. 限定不是撤回主張，而是說明它在哪些條件下成立。
D. 限定已取消主張在所有情況下的效力。
normal.explain: 明確把適用條件與放棄主張區分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The student has learned the grammar of dissent rather more readily than the discipline of examining a cherished assumption.
options: A. 學生已證明能對任何信念作徹底檢驗。
B. 異議的文法錯誤是唯一妨礙理解的原因。
C. 學生拒絕學習任何表達異議的方式。
D. 學生較快學會異議的表達形式，而非檢視珍視假設的自律。
normal.explain: grammar 此處比喻異議形式；比較兩種學會程度，非說完全沒有能力。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The objection is not that the scheme lacks coherence, but that its coherence has been purchased by excluding what would trouble it.
options: A. 說話者否認架構呈現任何一致性。
B. 架構的一致性已獨立證明所有案例都適用。
C. 問題不在架構不一致，而在一致性靠排除麻煩案例換得。
D. 架構因納入所有反例而變得不一致。
normal.explain: coherence 被承認，但取得方式受批評。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: There is a difference between teaching students to tolerate ambiguity and using ambiguity as a reason never to expose one’s own position to challenge.
options: A. 容忍歧義必然表示所有立場都不能受質疑。
B. 學生必須消除所有歧義後才可提出問題。
C. 說話者認為立場不明確總是較成熟的表現。
D. 容忍歧義與藉歧義保護自己立場免受挑戰不同。
normal.explain: 把處理不確定性的能力，與利用不確定性迴避責任分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is presented as intellectual modesty can become a remarkably comfortable position if it requires everyone else to justify their claims while exempting its own refusal to commit.
options: A. 若只要求他人辯護而不檢視自己拒絕表態，知識謙遜也可能成為舒適的特權立場。
B. 知識謙遜已被證明在每個情境都等同虛偽。
C. 拒絕表態必然比提出主張更需公開辯護。
D. 說話者肯定此立場已平等要求所有人負責。
normal.explain: can 和 if 限定批評條件，核心在不對等的辯護要求。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The lecturer is erudite without being ostentatiously so. What is the praise?
options: A. Extensive learning is evident but is not made into a conspicuous display.
B. The lecturer displays specialised vocabulary to compensate for little knowledge.
C. The lecturer conceals knowledge so completely that none is apparent.
D. The lecturer avoids any material that could reveal extensive reading.
normal.explain: erudite 是博學，without being ostentatiously so 表不炫耀；不是知識毫不顯露。

normal.desc: 【語用】A tutor says: That is an ingenious answer to a rather different question. What is the likely reservation?
options: A. The response is being recommended as a model answer to the original task.
B. The response shows skill but does not adequately address the task set.
C. The response addresses the task but lacks any originality.
D. The task was accidentally replaced after the student answered.
normal.explain: 稱讚 ingenious 同時指出答非所問，並非否定巧思。

normal.desc: 【語意】The analogy is illuminating up to a point. What qualification is retained?
options: A. Its explanatory value extends without qualification to every case.
B. It has been included solely to fill a gap in the presentation.
C. It offers insight within limits that should not be ignored.
D. It has no explanatory value even in its strongest application.
normal.explain: up to a point 限定類比的適用範圍，仍保留部分解釋價值。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The essay is praised for wearing its learning lightly. What does this suggest?
options: A. It treats accuracy as less important than an effortless appearance.
B. Its scholarship supports the writing without weighing it down.
C. It relies on very little knowledge and avoids supporting detail.
D. It makes its references conspicuous to impress the reader.
normal.explain: wear learning lightly 指博學而不賣弄、讀來不笨重；不是缺乏學問或忽略正確性。

normal.desc: 【範圍】No objection is too trivial to deserve a hearing. Which paraphrase is faithful?
options: A. Every objection should determine the final decision.
B. An objection becomes important simply because someone voices it.
C. Even apparently minor objections should be considered.
D. Only objections judged important in advance should be considered.
normal.explain: 值得被聽取不等於必須決定結果；no...too...to 包含輕微異議。

normal.desc: 【語意】The critic’s objection is immanent: it tests the theory against commitments the theory itself avows. What distinguishes the method?
options: A. It rejects the theory solely by imposing an unrelated standard.
B. It treats every declared commitment as fulfilled by definition.
C. It avoids assessing whether the theory keeps any commitment.
D. It identifies tension using the theory’s own declared standards.
normal.explain: 題幹定義 immanent criticism 為內在批判，依理論自己宣稱的標準檢驗。

normal.desc: 【語用】That is not a distinction I would wish to surrender merely for the sake of a tidier taxonomy. What is prioritised?
options: A. Replacing the distinction as soon as it complicates the scheme.
B. Treating neatness as sufficient evidence of conceptual accuracy.
C. Preserving a meaningful difference over making the classification neater.
D. Rejecting classification regardless of its usefulness.
normal.explain: merely for... 排除只為整齊就放棄區分，未否定所有分類。

normal.desc: 【短文】An examination rewards critical thinking through a list of approved phrases for challenging an author. Students learn to deploy the phrases while leaving their underlying assumptions untouched. What paradox emerges?
options: A. Learning shared phrases makes any genuine criticism impossible.
B. Students have been encouraged to abandon all conventions of argument.
C. The examination has stopped rewarding the appearance of critical engagement.
D. A performance of criticism can become a routine that protects assumptions from scrutiny.
normal.explain: 批判姿態可能例行化並掩護未檢視的假設；不主張共同表達必然阻止真批判。

normal.desc: 【短文】The teacher’s questions appear open-ended, yet each follow-up redirects pupils towards a conclusion fixed in advance. Alternatives are praised as interesting before being quietly set aside. What best describes the interaction?
options: A. The appearance of inquiry is maintained while its permissible destination is constrained.
B. The conclusion emerges entirely from pupils’ unanticipated contributions.
C. Every alternative is rejected explicitly before discussion begins.
D. The teacher abandons the planned conclusion whenever an alternative is raised.
normal.explain: 看似探究但終點預定；題幹並非公開拒絕所有其他回答。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以誇張動作取代所有台詞
B. 以不露聲色的方式說出幽默內容
C. 以明顯大笑提醒觀眾笑點
D. 以加快語速掩蓋忘詞
normal.explain: deadpan 是面無表情或不動聲色，幽默來自內容與表現反差。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因緊張而無法說話
B. 避免任何幽默而嚴肅指責
C. 表面認真卻帶玩笑或反諷意味
D. 字面承諾且完全不容置疑
normal.explain: tongue in cheek 指不全當真、帶幽默的表達。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因完全不懂對方而發出的質問
B. 要求暫停表演的正式命令
C. 證明事件確實發生的書面資料
D. 暗示彼此理解某個隱意的示意
normal.explain: knowing wink 可指眼神或敘事上與知情觀眾的會意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apparent throwaway line becomes less incidental with every recurrence.
options: A. 那句話在作品中只出現一次。
B. 說話者認為重複必定是作者疏失。
C. 看似隨口一句的話，愈反覆出現就愈不像無關緊要。
D. 那句話每次出現都證明與主題更加無關。
normal.explain: throwaway 與 less incidental 的變化顯示反覆賦予意義。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The poignancy lies not in what is said, but in how little the speakers can bring themselves to say.
options: A. 動人之處完全來自角色長篇解釋情緒。
B. 角色因沒有共同語言而完全不能交談。
C. 說話者認定角色不在乎彼此。
D. 動人之處在於角色難以說出口而只說了很少，而非字面內容本身。
normal.explain: bring themselves to say 表心理上難以開口，少言不等於無情。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The joke is at the narrator’s expense, although he appears to imagine that he is sharing it with us.
options: A. 敘事者以為和讀者一起開玩笑，實際上自己才是被取笑者。
B. 敘事者已清楚承認自己是笑柄。
C. 讀者被取笑而敘事者始終置身事外。
D. 這個玩笑只是在談實際支付的金額。
normal.explain: at someone’s expense 是以某人為笑柄；與自我理解形成落差。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The allusion rewards recognition, but the scene does not collapse for a reader who misses it.
options: A. 沒有認出典故就必定無法理解任何情節。
B. 典故與場景的意義完全無關。
C. 每位讀者都已被直接告知典故來源。
D. 認出典故會有額外收穫，但沒認出的讀者仍能理解場景。
normal.explain: reward recognition 與 not collapse 保留可分層理解。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What first appears to be a knowing parody gradually reveals an unease that the parodic pose cannot quite contain.
options: A. 最初看似通透的戲仿，逐漸露出那種姿態無法完全包住的不安。
B. 戲仿從頭到尾已充分消除所有不安。
C. 作品的不安只是因觀眾未辨識戲仿而產生。
D. 作品最後完全否定先前存在任何戲仿。
normal.explain: gradually reveals 描述表層姿態與更深情緒的張力，非簡單取代。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The elegance of the final sentence is deliberately compromised by a word that recalls the awkwardness the narrator has spent the chapter trying to edit out.
options: A. 敘事者已成功排除所有窘迫而沒有留下痕跡。
B. 末句刻意用一個字破壞優雅，喚回敘事者整章試圖刪去的窘迫。
C. 末句因偶然筆誤而失去原本已確立的優雅。
D. 那個字首次引入先前完全不存在的主題。
normal.explain: deliberately 與 recalls 支持有意回帶先前受壓抑內容。

normal.desc: 【語意】The review is acerbic rather than merely dismissive. What extra quality does acerbic suggest?
options: A. Its refusal to comment leaves the reader unable to infer any attitude.
B. Its criticism is sharply biting, not just withholding approval.
C. Its criticism is hesitant because the reviewer lacks a position.
D. Its approval is expressed with unusual warmth.
normal.explain: acerbic 指尖刻犀利，超過單純不予肯定。

normal.desc: 【語用】After describing a spectacularly inept rehearsal, the narrator adds: A promising start. Which reading is best grounded?
options: A. The narrator is referring to a different rehearsal not mentioned in the passage.
B. The phrase establishes that the performers themselves were optimistic.
C. The praise is ironic, with its force supplied by the preceding description.
D. The phrase sincerely revises every negative detail already given.
normal.explain: 前文失誤與表面讚語衝突，支撐反諷；無需假定另一次排練。

normal.desc: 【語意】The character’s laconic reply is not necessarily a sign of indifference. Which distinction matters?
options: A. Few words are conclusive evidence of concealed anger.
B. Any short reply necessarily communicates sincere agreement.
C. The reply contains too many words to reveal an attitude.
D. Few words do not by themselves establish a lack of concern.
normal.explain: laconic 是簡短，不能僅從字數判定內在不關心。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The account turns from the sublime to the bathetic when an exalted farewell ends in a dispute over taxi fares. What produces the effect?
options: A. An unresolved ambiguity about whether the characters are departing.
B. A consistently comic register maintained without tonal change.
C. A descent from elevated emotion into an incongruously trivial concern.
D. A gradual intensification of the farewell’s dignity.
normal.explain: bathos 指從高昂莊嚴突然落到瑣碎，題幹具體提供了落差。

normal.desc: 【立場】The critic admires the novel’s refusal of consolation without endorsing its cynicism. What is accepted?
options: A. Its distrustful worldview as the only possible account of life.
B. Its provision of an uncomplicated happy resolution.
C. Its claim that no reader could reasonably seek reassurance.
D. Its resistance to easy reassurance, not necessarily its distrustful worldview.
normal.explain: 拒絕廉價安慰與犬儒世界觀可分開評價。

normal.desc: 【語意】The pastiche is affectionate rather than parasitic. What distinction is intended?
options: A. Imitation is presented as appreciative engagement rather than mere exploitation.
B. Imitation is denied because the work contains no recognisable echoes.
C. The source is treated as worthless material to be discarded.
D. Affection is taken as proof that no borrowing has occurred.
normal.explain: pastiche 是仿作，形容詞對照借用的態度與功能，不是否認借用。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The narrator is unreliable in ways the text makes discoverable. What does this imply?
options: A. Every factual detail supplied by the narrator must be false.
B. The author offers no basis for distinguishing stronger and weaker readings.
C. Discovering unreliability removes the need to examine individual claims.
D. The text supplies grounds for revising at least some of the narrator’s claims.
normal.explain: 可發現的不可靠需要文本線索；不等於所有資訊皆假。

normal.desc: 【短文】A novelist gives the most eloquent speeches to a character whose conduct repeatedly undermines them. A critic quotes the speeches as the novel’s own settled convictions. What has the critic overlooked?
options: A. The distinction between rhetorical prominence and the work’s endorsement of a voice.
B. The fact that the character’s speeches are linguistically incoherent.
C. The impossibility of attributing any view to a literary work.
D. The certainty that every eloquent character is intended as a villain.
normal.explain: 角色說得漂亮不等於作品認同；行為與話語的張力是關鍵證據。

normal.desc: 【短文】The closing image repeats the opening, but the events between them have made its apparent innocence difficult to sustain. The repetition is exact; its effect is not. What accounts for the difference?
options: A. Exact repetition guarantees that the image retains an unchanged meaning.
B. The reader’s changed knowledge reconfigures the significance of the same image.
C. The image’s words have been replaced by an explicit explanation.
D. The novel has returned the reader to a state of complete ignorance.
normal.explain: 同一符號因閱讀歷程而改變意義，不需表面文字改動。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只有情況改變才可繼續
B. 無論先前說了什麼都表示同意
C. 即便如此，仍須回到另一個重點
D. 既然如此，所有異議都已被撤回
normal.explain: Be that as it may 是讓步轉折，不代表接受全部立場。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 保證接下來不會有任何反對
B. 要求對方先承認自己無知
C. 正式授予對方無限決策權
D. 在表示尊重的同時提出不同意見
normal.explain: 此語常在不同意見前作禮貌鋪墊；具體強度仍看上下文。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以間接或隱晦方式表達的威脅
B. 已明白宣布且毫無保留的命令
C. 完全沒有後果暗示的請求
D. 事後證明從未提出的承諾
normal.explain: veiled 指未直接明說，仍可由語境辨出壓力或後果。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He has conceded the wording with a generosity that leaves the substance remarkably undisturbed.
options: A. 他已放棄核心要求，只保留原來字句。
B. 他拒絕修改任何表面或實質部分。
C. 所有實質分歧都因措辭改變而消失。
D. 他在措辭上大方讓步，實質內容卻幾乎未動。
normal.explain: 措辭讓步不等於內容讓步，generosity 帶有可能的反諷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not impugn her motives, though I see no reason to treat the sincerity of those motives as a defence of the outcome.
options: A. 我不質疑她的動機，但真誠動機不足以替結果辯護。
B. 我把結果不佳視為證明她動機不誠。
C. 我認為動機真誠就足以證明結果正當。
D. 我否認動機與任何評價可能相關。
normal.explain: 不攻擊動機，同時不把動機當作結果正當性的充分理由。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation to exercise judgement is curiously bounded by the requirement that the judgement coincide with the preferred result.
options: A. 說話者確認每個判斷都已自然相同。
B. 邀請人自行判斷，卻要求結果符合預定偏好，界線很矛盾。
C. 自行判斷已被允許產生任何不同結果而無後果。
D. 邀請只涉及何時安排會議，與結論無關。
normal.explain: 名義裁量與實際可接受結論之間的限制受質疑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The disclaimer is doing much of the work that an explicit refusal would have done, while preserving the appearance that no refusal has occurred.
options: A. 免責說詞實際上發揮了多數拒絕作用，同時保留未拒絕的表象。
B. 免責說詞已明白同意所有要求。
C. 說話者只在比較兩份法律文件長度。
D. 明確拒絕與這段說詞在語用上完全無關。
normal.explain: 著重實際話語功能與表面承諾不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: One can acknowledge the tact of the formulation while noticing that its tact depends on making the other party infer a refusal the speaker declines to own.
options: A. 只要拒絕未明說，就不可能被合理推知。
B. 可以承認措辭圓融，同時看到它把推知拒絕的責任交給對方，說話者卻不明認。
C. 圓融措辭已使拒絕不存在。
D. 對方已明白接受拒絕且沒有任何解讀負擔。
normal.explain: 評價技巧與分配溝通責任可以分開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is offered as a concession to dissent may be a way of giving dissent a place from which it cannot affect anything consequential.
options: A. 說話者確認程序完全沒有讓異議出現。
B. 只要有固定發言位置，就必定能影響決定。
C. 看似容納異議的讓步，可能把異議安置在無法影響重大事項的位置。
D. 異議已被授予所有最終決策權。
normal.explain: 納入表達不必然等於實質影響，may 保留對機制的分析。

normal.desc: 【語意】The reply is solicitous without being obsequious. What balance is suggested?
options: A. It offers excessive flattery while withholding concern.
B. It avoids both concern and any recognition of the other person.
C. It shows attentive concern without excessive submissive flattery.
D. It conceals indifference behind an openly hostile manner.
normal.explain: solicitous 關切周到，obsequious 過度卑順奉承；兩者不相同。

normal.desc: 【語用】A chair says: I would not presume to tell you how to vote, immediately before explaining why every reasonable member must support the motion. What tension is evident?
options: A. The chair has refrained from expressing any preference.
B. The chair explicitly invites several choices as equally reasonable.
C. The motion has already been rejected by every member.
D. A disclaimer of influence accompanies pressure presented as the only reasonable choice.
normal.explain: 表面不干預與接著施壓形成矛盾，不需假定投票結果。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The assurance is placatory rather than probative. What distinction is made?
options: A. It seeks to soothe concern rather than establish the claim with evidence.
B. It supplies decisive evidence while intentionally provoking concern.
C. It withdraws the claim without addressing anyone’s feelings.
D. It has been accepted as proof precisely because it is unwelcome.
normal.explain: placatory 是安撫，probative 是有證明力；目的與證據力分開。

normal.desc: 【語意】The criticism impugns the judgement, not the judge’s integrity. What is challenged?
options: A. The person’s honesty as the reason to accept the decision.
B. The possibility of making any decision at all.
C. The right to examine the reasoning under any circumstances.
D. The soundness of the decision rather than the person’s honesty.
normal.explain: judgement 是判斷，integrity 是誠信，批評可針對前者而不攻擊後者。

normal.desc: 【語用】We are delighted to have such a spirited discussion, the manager says, before excluding every contested point from the minutes. What does the juxtaposition suggest?
options: A. The welcome for dissent may not extend to giving it an enduring official record.
B. The minutes preserve every disagreement as the basis for further action.
C. The manager has explicitly prohibited all future meetings.
D. The discussion was not spirited, since no disagreement occurred.
normal.explain: 口頭歡迎與紀錄刪除的並置，質疑異議能否留在正式程序中。

normal.desc: 【立場】The offer is no less coercive for being couched as a choice. What is asserted?
options: A. The offer has been withdrawn because its wording was impolite.
B. Presenting the offer as optional does not remove its coercive character.
C. The optional wording proves that coercion is absent.
D. Every choice is necessarily coercive regardless of its conditions.
normal.explain: no less...for... 否定措辭足以消除實質強迫，不是說所有選擇皆強迫。

normal.desc: 【語意】The deference is strategic rather than unthinking. What does this imply?
options: A. Respectful yielding is being used deliberately towards a purpose.
B. The speaker has no awareness of the hierarchy involved.
C. The speaker necessarily agrees with every substantive claim.
D. The interaction contains no outward sign of respect.
normal.explain: strategic 表有目的運用恭順，不等於完全同意或毫不自覺。

normal.desc: 【短文】An organisation calls its staff autonomous because they choose how to meet targets. The targets, resources and penalties are fixed elsewhere, and requests to revise them are treated as failures of initiative. What is the rhetorical function of autonomy here?
options: A. It openly acknowledges that initiative is irrelevant to assessment.
B. It may recast structurally constrained outcomes as matters of individual resourcefulness.
C. It establishes that staff control all conditions shaping their results.
D. It eliminates any distinction between choosing means and choosing ends.
normal.explain: 自主話語可能把結構限制轉成個人主動性問題；仍保留有限方法選擇的存在。

normal.desc: 【短文】The mediator summarises a demand for restored access as a wish for reassurance. The reformulation sounds conciliatory but removes the concrete remedy sought. What has changed?
options: A. The remedy has been strengthened by naming its practical requirements.
B. The mediator has reproduced the demand without altering its focus.
C. A claim about material conditions has been translated into a need for emotional comfort.
D. A request for comfort has been translated into a binding access guarantee.
normal.explain: 具體使用權被改述成安慰需求，和緩措辭改變了要求性質。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: damned if you do and damned if you do not
options: A. 只要選擇行動就一定成功
B. 已找到毫無代價的第三條路
C. 因沒有任何人反對而難以選擇
D. 做或不做都會受到責難的兩難
normal.explain: 此慣用語指兩邊都可能受責難，不預設真的沒有任何其他策略。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 表面稱讚卻暗含貶抑的話
B. 明確而沒有任何保留的讚美
C. 因聽錯而偶然產生的中立問題
D. 私下說出而不願公開的事實
normal.explain: backhanded compliment 的貶抑可藏在比較或預設之中。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 以站立姿勢閱讀正式文件
B. 過度拘泥禮節或正式規矩
C. 堅持參加每一場典禮
D. 主動放棄所有社交界線
normal.explain: stand on ceremony 是拘泥禮節，不是字面站在典禮上。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Her composure is not the absence of feeling, but a way of keeping the feeling from becoming everyone else’s obligation.
options: A. 她的沉著不是沒有感受，而是避免把感受變成別人的義務。
B. 她的沉著證明她對事情毫不在意。
C. 她已要求所有人替自己的感受負責。
D. 情緒被控制就表示它不曾存在。
normal.explain: 明確區分內在感受與向他人施加的要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He is punctilious about courtesy in a way that makes declining his offer seem like the only discourteous act left in the room.
options: A. 說話者只是稱讚他沒有任何施壓效果。
B. 他對禮貌極其周到，反讓拒絕提議看似成為現場唯一失禮行為。
C. 他的禮貌使拒絕和接受都被同等歡迎。
D. 他直接禁止任何人使用婉拒語句。
normal.explain: 形式禮貌可能構成間接壓力，未必有明文禁止。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The grievance is not that she failed to read his mind, but that an unspoken expectation is being retrospectively treated as a shared agreement.
options: A. 雙方從一開始就公開協議所有細節。
B. 說話者主張每個人本來都應能猜到他人想法。
C. 不滿不是她沒有讀心，而是未明說期待事後被當成共同協議。
D. 她已明確承諾卻在事後否認。
normal.explain: 批評期待被事後轉為義務，非要求讀心。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The invitation to choose is oddly weighted when one answer is described as generous and the other as a disappointment.
options: A. 只要有正負評價就能證明對方完全沒有選擇。
B. 當一種答案被稱大方、另一種被稱令人失望，選擇邀請便帶有不對等壓力。
C. 兩種答案已被給予相同且中立的評價。
D. 選擇因兩種答案都不存在而無法進行。
normal.explain: 描述框架影響選擇成本，但不等於邏輯上毫無選項。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is presented as an inability to say no may partly be a situation in which saying no has been made to carry an unreasonable emotional price.
options: A. 所有拒絕都必定傷害他人，因此不應嘗試。
B. 說話者確定任何人只要學一句話就能毫無代價地拒絕。
C. 所謂不會拒絕，部分可能是拒絕被賦予不合理情感代價的處境。
D. 拒絕能力完全與情境無關，只由個性決定。
normal.explain: may partly 保留個人與情境共同作用，不以單一因素定論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apology asks to be judged by the pain of making it rather than by the extent to which it names and repairs the harm.
options: A. 道歉已把全部注意力放在具體補救措施。
B. 道歉完全沒有涉及道歉者的感受。
C. 說話者認為作道歉必須毫無痛苦才算真誠。
D. 道歉希望按說出口有多痛苦受評價，而非按承認與修復傷害的程度。
normal.explain: 評價重心從受害與補救移到道歉者成本，並非否認痛苦可真實。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The response is rueful rather than remorseful. What distinction is most relevant?
options: A. It acknowledges grave wrongdoing while excluding any regret.
B. It expresses uncomplicated pleasure at the outcome.
C. It denies that the outcome has affected the speaker at all.
D. It conveys regret, perhaps with wry acceptance, without necessarily acknowledging moral guilt.
normal.explain: rueful 帶懊惱或苦笑，不必包含 remorseful 的深切悔罪。

normal.desc: 【語用】If you insist, she says, while already reaching for her coat. Which inference is best supported?
options: A. Her words present reluctant acquiescence, though her action may suggest readiness to go.
B. Her words constitute an explicit enthusiastic invitation to stay.
C. Her action proves that every earlier refusal was deliberately dishonest.
D. The statement guarantees that she will not leave.
normal.explain: 字面保留與行動準備形成可能張力；不能過度推成確定欺騙。

normal.desc: 【語意】His diffidence should not be confused with indifference. What is being distinguished?
options: A. A deliberate refusal from an already completed agreement.
B. Hesitant self-confidence from lack of interest or concern.
C. A lack of concern from an explicit hostile intention.
D. Confidence in others from an ability to remember details.
normal.explain: diffidence 是缺乏自信而羞怯，indifference 是漠不關心。

normal.desc: 【語意】The kindness is fastidious about appearances and less attentive to what would actually help. What is criticised?
options: A. Attention to looking considerate may exceed attention to the recipient’s needs.
B. Practical help is being offered with no concern for social presentation.
C. The recipient has explicitly rejected every possible form of help.
D. Careful attention to appearances always proves an absence of kindness.
normal.explain: 局部比較表象與實際助益，未斷言凡顧外觀皆無善意。

normal.desc: 【語用】I would never dream of imposing, the visitor says, before assuming that the spare room is available indefinitely. What makes the courtesy questionable?
options: A. The visitor refuses the room to avoid any inconvenience.
B. The disclaimer of imposition is undermined by an expansive presumption of hospitality.
C. The visitor explicitly asks how long the room may be used.
D. The host has already offered unlimited use in clear terms.
normal.explain: 客套否認打擾與無限期占用的假定相衝突。

normal.desc: 【範圍】It is not inconceivable that the silence was intended kindly. Which paraphrase matches the force?
options: A. The silence cannot reasonably have had any kindly intention.
B. Every instance of silence should be presumed kindly.
C. A kindly intention remains possible, though it is not established.
D. A kindly intention has been conclusively demonstrated.
normal.explain: not inconceivable 只保留可能，不是證實或普遍推定。

normal.desc: 【語意】The reassurance is soothing but subtly infantilising. What reservation is implied?
options: A. It openly states that the listener is a child.
B. It offers comfort while treating the listener as less capable of judgement than they are.
C. It offers no comfort because it uses incomprehensible vocabulary.
D. It empowers the listener by withholding every judgement.
normal.explain: infantilising 可為話語效果而非明說年齡；安慰與低估自主可並存。

normal.desc: 【短文】A family praises one member as endlessly obliging. When she declines a request, the refusal is described as unlike her, rather than considered on its merits. What function can the praise serve?
options: A. It prevents anyone from noticing a change in her conduct.
B. It recognises her refusal as the expected expression of independence.
C. It can make compliance part of an identity from which any boundary appears a deviation.
D. It establishes that every earlier agreement was freely chosen.
normal.explain: 稱讚可把順從固化為身分，讓設界線被視為失常。

normal.desc: 【短文】In recalling an argument, the narrator carefully records his own intentions and the other person’s actions. Her intentions appear only as his conjectures. What asymmetry should a reader notice?
options: A. Both participants’ motives are given through equally authoritative self-reports.
B. The account supplies no information about the narrator’s own perspective.
C. The other person’s actions are independently proved to reveal her motives.
D. One participant receives privileged access to motive while the other is interpreted mainly from outside.
normal.explain: 內在動機呈現不對等，限制讀者對雙方的公平比較。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 附在同意或承諾上的限制條件
B. 證明所有條件都不存在的文件
C. 無關主題的補充笑話
D. 已兌現完畢的最終款項
normal.explain: proviso 指附帶條件，不是全面保證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 明確宣布永久不予回覆的通知
B. 在尚未作實質答覆前先回覆的訊息
C. 已完整解決所有事項的最終決定
D. 只能以電話而不能書面提供的說明
normal.explain: holding response 通常先確認處理中，不等同實質結論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 主動取消原本所有權利
B. 在不知情下接受一份禮物
C. 經歷一連串嚴厲質疑或困難
D. 順利通過完全沒有障礙的流程
normal.explain: run the gauntlet 比喻經受連串挑戰，不需字面賽跑背景。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The response mistakes the existence of a channel for the availability of a usable remedy.
options: A. 問題只涉及通訊頻道名稱的拼寫。
B. 回覆把有管道誤當成實際有可使用的補救。
C. 回覆已證明每個管道都能有效補救。
D. 說話者否認任何聯絡方式存在。
normal.explain: 形式可聯繫與實質可補救不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The explanation is dilatory without quite being a refusal, which may be precisely its advantage from the provider’s point of view.
options: A. 解釋加速了程序且保證立即解決。
B. 說話者確認拖延一定是無意造成。
C. 解釋拖延卻不明拒，從提供者角度看，這可能正是好處。
D. 提供者已明確拒絕並承擔拒絕後果。
normal.explain: 保留may推測策略價值，不把動機當確證。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The qualification is easy to overlook because it appears to be clarifying the promise when it is actually withdrawing most of it.
options: A. 限定已把承諾明顯擴張到更多情況。
B. 承諾本來完全沒有任何實質內容可撤回。
C. 說話者只是在比較字體大小。
D. 限定容易被忽略，因它看似澄清承諾，實際撤掉大部分內容。
normal.explain: 澄清姿態與實質縮減的功能不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The insistence on consistency becomes less persuasive when it means repeating a response whose inadequacy has already been acknowledged.
options: A. 不足尚未被任何人指出。
B. 說話者主張每次回覆都必須互相矛盾。
C. 若一致性只是重複已承認不足的回覆，堅持一致就較難說服人。
D. 只要回覆一致，就自動消除所有不足。
normal.explain: 一致性不應成為不修正已知問題的理由。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is described as an unfortunate oversight has recurred often enough to make the language of accident an inadequate account of the pattern.
options: A. 每次事件都已被證明是預謀違規。
B. 只要事件重複，就不能再分析其原因。
C. 說話者主張第一次疏漏已證明所有流程無效。
D. 所謂不幸疏漏反覆到一定程度後，偶發事故的說法已不足以解釋模式。
normal.explain: 模式使偶發解釋不足，但不自動證成蓄意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The disclaimer preserves the provider’s freedom at the expense of the certainty that the headline assurance invites the customer to rely on.
options: A. 免責條款保留提供者彈性，卻犧牲標題保證讓顧客依賴的確定性。
B. 提供者與顧客的所有權利都同時擴大。
C. 顧客已被明確告知不得依賴任何標題內容。
D. 條款已消除提供者每種選擇空間。
normal.explain: 雙方確定性和彈性的分配是批評焦點。

normal.desc: 【語意】The response is perfunctory rather than merely brief. What does perfunctory add?
options: A. It suggests a routine effort made without sufficient care or engagement.
B. It suggests that brevity necessarily reflects careful consideration.
C. It establishes that the response was produced after a lengthy investigation.
D. It means the response cannot contain any accurate information.
normal.explain: perfunctory 帶敷衍意味，brief 只描述長度；不推成內容必假。

normal.desc: 【語用】Your patience is appreciated, says the notice, where no alternative to waiting is offered. What may the wording do?
options: A. Guarantee that the delay will end within a stated period.
B. Present enforced waiting as if it were a freely offered personal virtue.
C. Give travellers a clear choice between equally available alternatives.
D. Explicitly acknowledge that waiting has been imposed without consent.
normal.explain: 把被動等待稱為patience，可能把強制處境改寫為主動美德。

normal.desc: 【細微語意】The assurance is hedged to the point of evanescence. What is suggested?
options: A. Its wording is brief but gives an unequivocal guarantee.
B. Its effect is permanent because every exception has been removed.
C. Its qualifications leave almost no definite commitment to grasp.
D. Its qualifications make the promise unusually precise and extensive.
normal.explain: hedged 表附加保留，to the point of evanescence 比喻承諾幾乎消散。

normal.desc: 【語意】The explanation is exculpatory in effect, whatever its stated purpose. What distinction is made?
options: A. The explanation explicitly accepts unlimited responsibility.
B. Its practical tendency to absolve responsibility is separated from its declared intention.
C. Its declared purpose is accepted as conclusive evidence of its effect.
D. Every factual statement in it has been established as false.
normal.explain: whatever...purpose 把實際開脫效果與聲明目的分開。

normal.desc: 【語用】The agent repeatedly says the matter is being actively considered, while declining to identify any decision-maker or next step. What reservation is warranted?
options: A. The agent has explicitly promised a particular outcome and deadline.
B. Every consideration process must be concluded immediately.
C. The phrase may convey activity without specifying an accountable process.
D. The phrase proves that no employee has read the request.
normal.explain: 缺少責任人與步驟，使措辭難以轉為可追蹤程序；不證明完全沒人處理。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The refusal is not without a rationale, but that rationale scarcely exhausts the relevant considerations. What is maintained?
options: A. The refusal has no reason under any interpretation.
B. The existence of one reason makes the refusal conclusively justified.
C. Every other consideration has already been shown irrelevant.
D. A reason exists, though it does not settle the issue comprehensively.
normal.explain: 有限承認rationale，同時指出未涵蓋全部相關因素。

normal.desc: 【語意】The delay is being naturalised as an inevitability rather than owned as a consequence of choices. What is challenged?
options: A. The possibility that external conditions can ever cause delay.
B. The existence of any timetable before the delay occurred.
C. The presentation of a decision-dependent outcome as if no one could have acted otherwise.
D. The claim that every delay is caused by deliberate wrongdoing.
normal.explain: 批評掩蓋選擇責任，不一概排除外在因素或斷言惡意。

normal.desc: 【短文】A help system asks users to choose the category that best describes their problem. Every category assumes a completed transaction, while the problem is that no transaction could be completed. Failed attempts to submit are later counted as no complaints received. What is obscured?
options: A. The framework has independently established that every attempted transaction succeeded.
B. Users have explicitly withdrawn complaints after receiving satisfactory remedies.
C. No categorisation system can ever collect useful information.
D. The absence of recorded complaints may reflect exclusion by the reporting framework itself.
normal.explain: 分類預設可能讓問題無法進入紀錄，不能以零紀錄推零問題。

normal.desc: 【短文】The provider promises flexibility but defines every permissible change as one already allowed under the original rigid terms. The promise adds no option, though its language suggests new freedom. What is the central criticism?
options: A. An unchanged entitlement is being redescribed as an additional concession.
B. The original terms have been expanded in every material respect.
C. The provider has openly withdrawn the language of flexibility.
D. All customers previously lacked any permissible change.
normal.explain: 重新包裝原有權利，不是新增實質讓步。

normal.desc: 請拼出：例行敷衍而未投入足夠心力的（P 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：造成拖延而不積極處理的（D 開頭，8 個字母）

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只有聲音而沒有任何事件發生
B. 表面贏得但缺乏實質價值的勝利
C. 完全未經任何爭取就失敗的結果
D. 已被所有人視為圓滿的成功
normal.explain: hollow victory 指代價或缺乏實質成果使勝利空洞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 實際裝有毒液的物品且不能有比喻義
B. 不需任何責任的短暫邀請
C. 看似值得接受卻伴隨重大困難的機會
D. 已被明確排除任何風險的獎賞
normal.explain: poisoned chalice 常比喻表面有利卻難以承擔的職位或機會。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 公開撤回先前每項承諾
B. 為某項服務預先付清全部費用
C. 透過書面詳細證明履約
D. 口頭表示支持卻缺乏相應行動
normal.explain: pay lip service 指口惠而實不至。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The language of duty becomes selective precisely where the ruler’s own obligations would begin.
options: A. 所有人已被明確免除每種責任。
B. 說話者只是在解釋義務這個字的拼法。
C. 義務話語在本應談統治者責任之處開始選擇性適用。
D. 統治者與人民已承擔完全相同且全部履行的義務。
normal.explain: 選擇性適用指責任要求的不對稱。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apparent magnanimity depends on our accepting that the power to forgive includes the prior right to define an objection as an offence.
options: A. 赦免已明確否定把異議視為過錯。
B. 每個異議都已獲獨立證實具有相同危害。
C. 說話者認為所有寬容都必然虛假。
D. 表面寬宏仰賴我們先接受：赦免者本有權把異議定為過錯。
normal.explain: 檢視赦免姿態背後預設的定罪權，不一概否定寬容。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: He need not be mendacious for the account to be misleading; he may sincerely fail to notice the facts his position makes inconvenient.
options: A. 敘述要有誤導性不必出於說謊；他也可能真誠忽略對自身立場不利的事實。
B. 誤導敘述已證明他刻意捏造每個事實。
C. 只要相信自己，任何敘述就不會誤導。
D. 不方便的事實已被他完整列出並接受。
normal.explain: 意圖誠實與資訊偏差可並存，may 留下可能性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The oath is invoked as though fidelity to its words settled fidelity to its purpose.
options: A. 說話者已確認字句與目的在所有情境都相反。
B. 誓言完全沒有任何可供解釋的文字。
C. 所有人已共同重新定義誓言目的。
D. 誓言被援引得好像忠於字句就已等於忠於其目的。
normal.explain: 字面遵守與目的實現不必自動相同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is presented as a rebellion against authority may be an insistence that authority remain answerable to the grounds on which it originally claimed obedience.
options: A. 所謂反叛權威，可能是在要求權威仍須回應其最初要求服從的理由。
B. 反對者已明確拒絕任何可能正當的權威。
C. 原本的服從理由已由所有人正式撤回。
D. 權威只要曾獲服從就永遠不需說明。
normal.explain: 挑戰可訴諸原有正當性標準，不必是全面否定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The victory is hollow not because nothing has changed, but because the change leaves untouched the power to recreate the grievance at will.
options: A. 說話者認為改變只要有限就完全沒有價值。
B. 勝利空洞不是因毫無改變，而是仍保留可任意重造不滿的權力。
C. 勝利已移除所有造成不滿的可能條件。
D. 沒有任何改變發生，這是唯一批評。
normal.explain: 承認改變，但指出根源權力未受限制。

normal.desc: 【語意】The decree’s ostensible purpose is protection. What does ostensible signal?
options: A. The decree has no publicly stated purpose at all.
B. Protection is the stated or apparent purpose, which may differ from the actual one.
C. Protection has been independently proved to be the only purpose.
D. Protection is explicitly denied as any part of the purpose.
normal.explain: ostensible 區分表面聲稱與未必相同的實際目的，不直接證明虛假。

normal.desc: 【語用】The ruler says, You are free to object, provided you remain worthy of my protection. What undermines the offer?
options: A. People have already been given sole authority over the ruler.
B. The condition concerns only the spelling of an objection.
C. The condition may make the exercise of objection threaten the protection on which people depend.
D. The offer explicitly guarantees protection regardless of any objection.
normal.explain: 自由表態附上模糊的保護資格條件，可能製造實質壓力。

normal.desc: 【語意】The oath is described as inviolable. Which meaning is intended?
options: A. It cannot be pronounced aloud.
B. It has already been withdrawn by everyone involved.
C. It is too vague to contain any commitment.
D. It is treated as not to be broken or infringed.
normal.explain: inviolable 指不可侵犯或違背，不是無法發音。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The proclamation grants, with great solemnity, permission to do what no one had previously forbidden. What is the effect?
options: A. The permission is described as informal and reluctantly given.
B. The people are shown to have possessed no prior freedom of action.
C. Authority is theatrically asserted through a concession that adds little substantive freedom.
D. The proclamation establishes that a severe restriction has been removed.
normal.explain: 隆重授予本已可做之事，宣示權威卻不增實質自由。

normal.desc: 【立場】The captain’s probity is not in question; the wisdom of the command remains so. What distinction is sustained?
options: A. Questioning an order necessarily impugns the captain’s honesty.
B. The order has been accepted as wise because the captain is honest.
C. The captain’s integrity has been explicitly rejected.
D. Personal integrity does not settle the soundness of a particular order.
normal.explain: 誠信與具體判斷是否明智可分開。

normal.desc: 【語意】The promise is elastic where restraint is required and rigid where recourse is sought. What asymmetry is criticised?
options: A. Its interpretation expands the ruler’s freedom while narrowing others’ remedies.
B. It applies the same interpretive flexibility to both sides.
C. It grants broad remedies while strictly constraining the ruler.
D. It contains no terms that anyone can interpret.
normal.explain: elastic/rigid 用於不同權利方向，呈現有利一方的解釋不對稱。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The warning is not wholly devoid of substance, though its substance is narrower than the obedience it demands. What is acknowledged?
options: A. The warning contains no information with any possible basis.
B. Every demand is justified by the mere presence of one real concern.
C. The warning establishes that no obedience could ever be reasonable.
D. Some danger may be real, while the demanded compliance exceeds what that danger establishes.
normal.explain: 有限承認事實基礎，同時限制可證成的服從範圍。

normal.desc: 【短文】A ruler claims that the people’s gratitude proves his authority legitimate. The gratitude follows the return of grain his own agents had seized. Dissent is then called ingratitude. What should be examined?
options: A. Whether relief from a harm created by the authority is being used to validate that authority and delegitimise challenge.
B. Whether the grain’s return proves that the original seizure never occurred.
C. Whether grateful people are incapable of expressing any reasoned view.
D. Whether every authority must be illegitimate whenever anyone is grateful.
normal.explain: 造成困境後施惠、再以感激要求正當性，形成自我證成與壓制異議的模式。

normal.desc: 【短文】The treaty permits resistance to unlawful commands but lets the issuer determine conclusively which commands are lawful. Its safeguard appears robust until the allocation of interpretation is considered. What is the flaw?
options: A. Lawfulness is treated as irrelevant to the treaty’s operation.
B. The protected right depends on a classification controlled by the power it is meant to constrain.
C. The treaty gives opponents unlimited power to define every command.
D. The safeguard has no words referring to resistance at all.
normal.explain: 權力制衡取決於被制衡者單方定義，可能掏空保護。

請唸出單字：表裡不一而欺瞞的行為
請唸出：表面上出於善意的法令
請唸出：有利於解釋者自身的解讀
請唸出：真誠可能與方便自身的道德盲點共存

normal.speak: sincerity can coexist with a convenient moral blindness
normal.vocabId: R8:SINCERITY CAN COEXIST WITH A CONVENIENT MORAL BLINDNESS

normal.speak: the safeguard depends on the power it constrains

請拼出：表面聲稱而未必是真正的（O 開頭，10 個字母）

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 酸得令人皺眉
B. 完全沒有可察覺的甜味
C. 甜得令人發膩
D. 甜得恰到好處
normal.explain: cloyingly 加入過量而不悅的評價。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 層次鮮明而濃郁的湯底
B. 尚未加入任何水的乾料
C. 香氣強烈而辛辣的湯底
D. 淡而乏味的湯底
normal.explain: insipid 是乏味，不是正面清雅。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 尾韻帶有使口腔收澀的感覺
B. 尾韻只有濃厚奶油感
C. 入口立即消失而毫無餘味
D. 只能用視覺辨認的顏色
normal.explain: astringent 指收斂澀感，不等於單純酸或苦。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 刻意只提供清水的安排
B. 用來塗抹的少量膠水
C. 食物已售罄後的空桌
D. 豐盛豪華的一桌餐食
normal.explain: spread 在此指鋪陳的一桌食物，sumptuous 豪華豐盛。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The austerity seems earned rather than affected: nothing feels omitted merely to advertise how much has been left out.
options: A. 簡約顯得有根據而非做作，沒有只是為炫耀刪減而省略的感覺。
B. 簡約被說成完全為了炫耀省略。
C. 評論者要求菜餚加入所有可能食材。
D. 菜單已被證明遺失部分頁面。
normal.explain: earned/affected 對比有實質依據與刻意姿態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The dish courts nostalgia without quite surrendering to it, allowing the remembered flavour to remain a point of departure rather than a destination.
options: A. 評論者斷言懷舊與創新無法共存。
B. 料理借助懷舊卻未完全屈從，把記憶滋味當起點而非終點。
C. 料理被要求精確複製記憶且不容變化。
D. 料理完全避開任何熟悉味道。
normal.explain: 保留懷舊影響但不受它完全限定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The provenance is impeccable; whether it tells us much about the pleasure of eating the dish is another question.
options: A. 來源無可挑剔，但它能否說明用餐樂趣仍是另一回事。
B. 來源已被證明虛假，滋味因此不必討論。
C. 來源好就已充分證明食用體驗美好。
D. 評論者認為不應追問任何來源。
normal.explain: 認可來源，同時拒絕來源自動決定感官品質。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The review turns the diner’s inability to recognise an ingredient into evidence of the chef’s sophistication, without considering that obscurity may simply be obscurity.
options: A. 說話者斷言任何陌生味道都毫無價值。
B. 評論把食客認不出食材當作主廚高深的證據，卻沒考慮難辨或許只是難辨。
C. 食材難辨已充分證明烹飪高明。
D. 所有食客都被描述為準確辨認食材。
normal.explain: 質疑由難以辨識跳到高明的推論，不否定所有陌生風味。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is not that the meal lacked pleasure, but that its insistence on being an experience seemed curiously distrustful of pleasure left to speak for itself.
options: A. 評論者認為愉悅必須靠詳解才存在。
B. 餐廳已拒絕向客人介紹任何內容。
C. 餐點並非沒有樂趣，只是堅持宣示體驗，顯得不信任樂趣自行呈現。
D. 餐點完全無樂趣，這是唯一批評。
normal.explain: 承認愉悅，批評過度宣示的框架可能壓過直接感受。

normal.desc: 【語意】The dessert is cloying. In a review of its sweetness, what does this imply?
options: A. Its temperature prevents the reviewer tasting it.
B. Its acidity dominates despite an absence of sugar.
C. Its sweetness becomes excessive and unpleasant.
D. Its sweetness is too faint to detect.
normal.explain: cloying 指過甜等造成膩感；明確限定甜度義。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The meal was not so much austere as unwilling to court attention. What distinction is the critic making?
options: A. Its lack of pleasure was the sole basis of the praise.
B. It sought attention through a conspicuously lavish style.
C. It was both severe and showy in precisely the same respect.
D. It avoided display without necessarily feeling harshly plain.
normal.explain: not so much ... as ... 修正定性；不求注目不等於苦澀簡陋。

normal.desc: 【文法】The dish, albeit ___ with skill, felt oddly detached from the rest of the menu.
options: A. executed
B. executing
C. to executing
D. it executed
normal.explain: albeit executed with skill 是讓步省略，dish 是被製作的對象。

normal.desc: 【語意】The critic finds the broth insipid, not merely delicate. What is being denied?
options: A. That the broth has any lack of flavour.
B. That delicate food can ever be enjoyable.
C. That the critic has tasted the broth.
D. That its lack of force amounts to a pleasing subtlety.
normal.explain: insipid 是淡而乏味；not merely delicate 拒絕把缺味美化為細緻。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The menu describes every ingredient as a discovery, leaving little room for the people who had cooked with them for generations. What is the criticism?
options: A. A rhetoric of novelty sidelines existing culinary knowledge.
B. Every ingredient has only recently come into existence.
C. The restaurant must stop using ingredients known elsewhere.
D. The critic objects to any explanation of an ingredient.
normal.explain: discovery 的話語抹去既有知識，不否定跨文化使用或介紹本身。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The service was immaculate; the welcome, less so. Which contrast is made?
options: A. The critic says the staff did not serve the meal.
B. Technical faultlessness did not extend equally to a sense of being warmly received.
C. The staff made many technical errors but were unusually welcoming.
D. The welcome was rated equally faultless.
normal.explain: less so 承接 immaculate；專業程序與溫暖感不同。

normal.desc: 【文法】Such was the confidence of the cooking ___ the elaborate introduction felt superfluous.
options: A. that
B. than
C. what
D. as if
normal.explain: Such was ... that ... 表程度與結果，非比較級 than。

normal.desc: 【短文】A critic declares a regional dish authentic when made by a celebrated visitor but provincial when made by cooks from that region. No difference in preparation is identified. What tension should a reader examine?
options: A. Whether authenticity and provinciality must always be antonyms.
B. Whether prestige attached to the cook is doing the work attributed to culinary criteria.
C. Whether the visitor necessarily invented the dish.
D. Whether regional cooks are unable to change a recipe.
normal.explain: 在未提出做法差異時，評價轉變可能依名望而非宣稱的料理標準；並未證明動機。

normal.desc: 【語用】The review praises the restaurant’s refusal to sentimentalise its origins, then faults it for failing to reproduce the reviewer’s remembered childhood. What inconsistency emerges?
options: A. It supplies evidence that the reviewer had no childhood connection.
B. It proves that the restaurant has concealed its origins.
C. It commends independence from nostalgia while imposing a nostalgic benchmark.
D. It consistently rejects all personal memory as irrelevant.
normal.explain: 先讚不感傷追憶，又以童年回憶要求重現，判準有張力。

🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
